text.p: Printing and publishing firm SNP Corporation Ltd (SNP) said on Wednesday it expected full year results for 1997 to be worse than 1996.
It reported a loss of Singapore $1.8 million for the six months to June 30.
"The board does not expect group results this year to be better than last," SNP said in a statement accompanying the interim results.

SNP said competition in the general printing business had hit sales, margins and ultimately profits while its planned retrenchment from the sector and move into multimedia products would take some time.
"The group will shrink its unprofitable printing business and continue to move to IT (information technology) and multimedia products and services," it said.
SNP added it would "take some time (for them) to be profitable".
